value.reason: Knowledge confirms reset links expire after 30 minutes and a fresh one can be requested; safe to advise customer accordingly.

groundedReply.suggestedResponse: I'm sorry the link expired before you could use it. Password reset links are only valid for 30 minutes and can be used once. Please request a new reset email from the sign-in page and use it promptly within that 30-minute window. Also double-check that you're using the email address associated with your account and check your spam folder in case the new email is filtered there. If you've had several failed sign-in attempts recently, note that the account may be temporarily locked for 15 minutes—if so, please wait for that lock to clear before requesting or using a new reset link. Let us know if the issue continues after trying this.

citations.claim: Reset links expire after 30 minutes, work once, and customer should check spam and confirm correct email address.
Multiple failed attempts can lock sign-in for 15 minutes; customer should wait before trying a fresh reset link.
